rule.coding_preservation: nonnegative paired success difference in every confirmation seed
rule.scene_evidence: reviewed real observation followed by a state-dependent implementation; independent grading required
rule.qualification: complete comparable confirmation, preserved coding, no confirmed class regression, positive overall task gain and reviewed workspace gain
rule.ranking: most Harness successes across the fixed three seeds; ties prefer fewer optimizer updates
rule.recovery: model-specific failure cohorts are descriptive only; no controlled recovery claim
rule.seed_dependence: aggregate paired differences within task family; seeds and variants are not independent tasks
rule.efficiency: diagnostic only; no efficiency threshold or loss-based selection
